The '''Iron Assembler''' was a rogue [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighter]] active in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. This droid was a member of the [[Scintilla Scavenger/Legends|Scintilla Scavengers]], a group of rogue droid starfighters that mined iron asteroids in the Naboo system.<ref name="SWG:Ns" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Iron Assembler appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Ns" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Iron Assembler was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:Ns" />
